question: Identify the antonym of 'Axiom':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Absurdity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Axiom"** refers to a universally accepted principle or rule that is self-evident or requires no proof. (स्वयंसिद्ध सत्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The statement "All men are mortal" is an axiom in philosophy.
 
 
• The word **"Absurdity"** refers to something that is illogical, unreasonable, or nonsensical. It is the opposite of an axiom, which is rooted in truth and logic. (असंगति/अर्थहीनता)
 
 
• **Example:** The idea that pigs can fly is an absurdity.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Axiom'** is **'Absurdity'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Absurdity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Truism** (सत्य वचन): A statement that is obviously true and says nothing new or interesting.
 
 
• **Example:** "Honesty is the best policy" is a truism that everyone agrees with.
 
 

 
• **Adage** (लोकोक्ति): A traditional saying expressing a common experience or observation.
 
 
• **Example:** The adage "A stitch in time saves nine" encourages timely action to prevent bigger problems.
 
 

 
• **Principle** (सिद्धांत): A fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation for a system of belief or behavior.
 
 
• **Example:** He stuck to his principles even when it was difficult to do so.
